purpose: Preserve post-B8 evidence decisions without rewriting historical tranche ledgers or weakening canonical identity boundaries.

observations: Ciqual 2025 exposes generic Paprika, powder (alimCode 11049), not an exact smoked-paprika food identity.
The existing USDA Foundation B8 review found no exact smoked-paprika Foundation candidate.
No exact authoritative composition record meeting the current identity, provenance, constituent and semantic requirements was admitted in this review.
smoked_paprika.boundary: Generic paprika, pepper powder, branded/commercial records and inferred equivalence remain inadmissible for canonical smoked_paprika.

basmati_rice.boundary: B9 maps only canonical basmati_rice. It does not authorize generic rice, jasmine rice or other rice-form inference.

lemon.boundary: B10 may fill only tracked lemon fields absent from all existing reviewed USDA/Ciqual candidates. Existing populated Ciqual lemon fields remain selected; B10 does not replace them or broaden lemon to juice/peel forms.

cumin.boundary: B11 maps only canonical cumin as ground cumin. It does not authorize a separate whole-cumin-seed identity or generic spice-family inference.

turmeric.boundary: B11 maps only canonical turmeric as ground turmeric. It does not authorize whole-root turmeric or generic spice-family inference.

red_lentils.boundary: B11 maps only canonical red_lentils, including its red split lentils alias. It does not authorize generic lentils, cooked lentils or canned lentils.

olive_oil.boundary: B12 may fill only olive_oil carbohydrate because that tracked field is absent from all existing reviewed USDA/Ciqual candidates. Populated Ciqual B5 energy, protein, fat and fibre remain selected. The exact extra-virgin record is supported by the canonical EVOO alias and does not authorize other oil families.

tomato.boundary: B13 may fill only tomato fat because that tracked field is absent from all existing reviewed USDA/Ciqual candidates. Populated Ciqual B5 energy, protein, carbohydrate and fibre remain selected. The exact unspecified raw record does not authorize cultivar-specific, cooked, canned or processed tomato forms.

cherry_tomato.boundary: B13 may fill only cherry_tomato fat because that tracked field is absent from all existing reviewed USDA/Ciqual candidates. Populated Ciqual B5 fields remain selected. Imported origin does not broaden this row to generic tomato, cooked tomato or non-cherry varieties.

courgette.boundary: B14 maps only canonical courgette, whose ontology explicitly includes zucchini as an alias. It does not authorize generic squash, pumpkin, cooked courgette or cultivar-specific inference.
